Explanation of the change:

- Previously the rule began at `` ` `` and ended at end‐of‐line (`'$'`), so comments and all remaining text were scoped as “meta.”
- The new `begin: /`[A-Za-z_]\w*/` regex matches only a back‐tick plus a Verilog identifier.  Comments (`// ...`) and the rest of the code now fall out of the meta rule and are tokenized correctly by the existing comment and normal-code rules.
